name: Bulk Update Title Node
description: Find-and-replace node titles in bulk for a chosen content type, run through the Batch API.
project_description:
What's "Bulk Update Title Node" ? 
 This module allows to replace the partial or full title of one or more nodes with another depends on the content type selected.

 How to use this module ? 
 After the installation, go to /admin/content/bulk-update, select the content type, the old title, and the new title and click on replace, All titles which have the content type selected will be replaced.

 Please provide feedback and ideas to improve it!

 Complementary modules 
 Bulk Delete This module will delete any nodes of a certain node-type using the batch api..
